title: Integral stratified perfect closure under truncations
statement: theorem integralStratifiedPerfectClosure_truncation (T : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] [IsNoetherian T] (_hdim : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n) (_hl : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (K : PbcCompletedDerived T (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) (hK : PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) K) (n : ℤ) : PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLE n).obj K) ∧ PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE n).obj K)

proof.text: The standalone truncation split is withdrawn. Its sole parent integralStratifiedPerfectClosure now proves the truncation clause directly from the existing integralStratifiedPerfectCharacterization: both truncations preserve the original bounded interval and their cohomology sheaves are the permitted sheaves or zero. The permitted local-module property is isomorphism-invariant; vanishing cohomology above the upper bound supplies its zero case. The complete replacement argument is in the parent module and needs no standalone truncation declaration.
